verdict.rationale: The marketing site says users can describe the game they want and 'Summer builds it with you', which implies a first-party AI builder inside the engine. The line that external agents get 'the same tools' also suggests a native agent exists. Most of the documentation instead covers connecting external agents (Claude Code, Codex) via MCP/CLI, which is not a built-in assistant and earns no credit here. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the built-in assistant's interface and delegation scope, details of what tasks it can execute autonomously, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the game you want and Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay.
Bring Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or whatever agent you prefer, and it gets the same tools.
